cohort: Singleton children born in Norway, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark between 1984 and 2015, categorized by those born after Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) and those born after spontaneous conception (SC).
finding: This study found no significant difference in the risk of cardiovascular disease or type 2 diabetes between children born after ART and those after SC, but observed a small yet significant increased risk of obesity for children born after ART.
followup_time: Mean of 8.6 years (SD 6.2) for ART children and 14.0 years (SD 8.6) for SC children.
birth_weight: Included all singleton children; prevalence of low birth weight (<2,500 g) was 5.7% for ART and 3.3% for SC.
gest_age: Included all singleton children; prevalence of preterm birth (<37 weeks 0 days) was 7.9% for ART and 4.8% for SC.
